parsed.explanation: State-directed targeting dominates: an extremism designation with 101 convictions, mass venue raids (patrons searched, photographed), and propaganda statutes enforced 180+ times in one year — arrests for displaying symbols. A visitor to any LGBT venue or expressing support carries real arrest exposure, with no anti-discrimination protection, no hate-crime recording, and the country having left the oversight court. Detention carries documented lethal risk (death in custody, Dec 2024), coercion and conversion violence against a trans woman, and birth-sex-coupled marriage voiding. Public hostility is high (74% disapproval) and a top-level travel advisory flags LGBT risk. The 2023 ban on legal gender change and dysphoria-based restrictions are partly resident-facing, but signal official hostility. Border treatment of mismatched foreign documents is undocumented (open question, not an exposure). No execution regime is documented, keeping this above the 0.05-0.15 tier.
